definition_english: Formally posited on paper as operative from a prior or stipulated date to compute seniority, promotional standing, pay-scale progression, or pension entitlement without physical incumbency or retrospective cash arrears.
definition_hindi: वास्तविक पदभार ग्रहण या पूर्वव्यापी नकद बकाया के बिना वरिष्ठता, पदोन्नति-क्रम, वेतनमान प्रगति अथवा पेंशन पात्रता की संगणना के लिए किसी पूर्वगामी या नियत तिथि से अभिलेखों में औपचारिक रूप से प्रभावी माना गया।

etymology.root_language: Latin (via Middle English and Medieval Latin)
etymology.historical_development: Formed from notion + -al (Latin -ālis). Specialized in 20th- and 21st-century Indian administrative and service-law practice to designate paper-based retrospective seniority, promotion, pay fixation, and pension-reckoning increments without physical incumbency or back wages.

equivalence_mapping.usage_status: Directly attested in UPSC 7th CPC pension circular (2017), UP Finance Dept Vitta-Path (2011), and Jaipur District Court order (2026)
Directly attested in UT Lakshadweep notice (2021), UP Finance Dept (2011), and Jaipur District Court order (2026); often paired with नोशनल to block 'fictitious' misreading
Attested as a grouped heading variant in UP Finance Dept Vitta-Path (2011) alongside काल्पनिक, नोशनल, and प्रोफार्मा
Not yet established in directly opened service-law orders; directly opened LPAI CSTT PDF and Hindi Wiktionary Parliamentary glossary did not yield extractable S2 entries

syntactic_patterns: non-gradable classifying attributive modifier before service-law nouns (notional promotion, notional increment)
prepositional phrase framing basis (on a notional basis)

hindi.number: Invariable (अविकारी); agreement carried by modified noun

hindi.adjective_agreement: Invariable (अविकारी / अपरिवर्तनीय); does not inflect for gender, number, or case

morphology.structure: Direct Devanagari transliteration of English notional

syntactic_patterns: attributive pre-nominal modifier (नोशनल पदोन्नति, नोशनल / काल्पनिक लाभ)
basis phrase with आधार पर (नोशनल आधार पर)
temporal-ablative retrospective anchor with से (पूर्वगामी तिथि से नोशनल पदोन्नति)
paired with passive/impersonal administrative predicates (नियत करना, देय होना)

register_and_pragmatics.academic_register: Pragmatic bureaucratic, administrative, and judicial service-law register
register_and_pragmatics.connotation: Neutral-legal; affirms enforceable seniority, pay-scale progression, and pension rights without retrospective cash arrears
cultural_nuances: Contemporary Indian service orders retain the English loanword नोशनल or pair it with काल्पनिक (नोशनल / काल्पनिक लाभ) to prevent readers from misinterpreting binding paper entitlements as imaginary or fraudulent.
usage_restrictions: Do not translate S2 with फ़र्ज़ी (fraudulent) or ख़्याली (whimsical).
Do not use अवधारणात्मक, धारणात्मक, or आनुमानिक in pay-fixation or promotion orders.
Reject the documented Shabdkosh inversion व्यावहारिक रूप से ('practically') for notionally.

linguistic_analysis.morphosyntax: English notional acts as a non-gradable classifying adjective in S2. Hindi नोशनल (loanword) and काल्पनिक (kalpanā + -ika with vṛddhi) are both invariable adjectives; gender and number agreement fall entirely on the modified head noun (e.g., feminine पदोन्नति, वेतन वृद्धि; masculine वेतन, लाभ).
linguistic_analysis.pragmatic_loanword_retention: Although नोशनल lacks native morphological transparency, it outperforms native adjectives in operative pay-fixation rules (e.g., UP Finance Dept Vitta-Path) by preserving exact service-law jurisprudence.

conceptual_analysis.core_distinction: Separates deemed continuous service and paper pay progression (for seniority and pension computation) from actual physical incumbency and retrospective monetary arrears, as defined in CAT Chandigarh Bench jurisprudence.
conceptual_analysis.domain_boundary: Distinct from S1 philosophical abstraction, S3 financial derivative reference bases and tax assessments, and S4 semantic grammatical concord.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both are directly attested in Indian administrative and judicial service orders for paper-based pay, pension, and promotion benefits.
pairwise_comparison.difference: नोशनल preserves exact service-law boundaries without ambiguity, whereas काल्पनिक activates the colloquial sense of 'imaginary/fabricated' (फ़र्ज़ी/मनगढ़ंत) unless stabilized by context or paired with नोशनल.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: High in operational service orders, though नोशनल is preferred in binding pay-fixation clauses to eliminate legal ambiguity.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both appear together in UP Finance Department's grouped heading for retrospective pro forma promotion.
pairwise_comparison.difference: सैद्धांतिक shifts meaning toward 'in principle / doctrinal' (सिद्धांत संबंधी) and is not sustained in binding operative pay-fixation rules where नोशनल is used exclusively.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Low in operative service-law clauses; avoid सैद्धांतिक for pay fixation or increments.

pairwise_comparison.semantic_overlap: Both derive from Sanskrit √kalp- and appear across Indian institutional terminology.
pairwise_comparison.difference: काल्पनिक is directly attested in opened operational service orders (UT Lakshadweep, Jaipur Metro-II Court, UP Finance Dept) but carries stronger fictional connotations; कल्पित ('posited/assumed') is conceptually tighter but its attestation in opened service-law orders is not yet established.
pairwise_comparison.interchangeability: Partial; काल्पनिक is currently attested in live service orders while कल्पित remains unverified in opened service-law texts.

proposed_terminology.justification: नोशनल and काल्पनिक are already entrenched across central, state, and judicial service orders; institutional harmonization across CSTT and DoPT is needed rather than a new coinage.

overall_confidence: Moderate — English service-law scope and operational Hindi equivalents (नोशनल, काल्पनिक, सैद्धांतिक) are directly verified across opened central, state, and judicial orders, but standalone CSTT standardization and direct verification of कल्पित in opened service-law texts remain unconfirmed.
